skeptic.argument: Second pass in a row where I have looked for something to overturn and found nothing. Every open must-finding names a file and a line, and every one of them is above 0.75 confidence. I have no objection left to make.

builder.argument: Every recommendation now names the change concretely enough to start work from. The only remaining edit is the density finding, whose confidence has sat at 0.6 since pass 1 because nobody has looked at a real long inbox — worth saying so on the finding rather than leaving the number unexplained.

dreamer.argument: I have tried two reframes this pass — reading the set by dimension rather than by screen, and reading it as a first-run journey — and both reproduce the same three priorities. When the reframes stop producing new orderings, the set has settled.

empath.argument: Ranking is stable across three passes now. Nothing to add.
